🧠 2. Executive Summary
A high-severity multi-stage intrusion campaign was detected spanning 9 distinct attack chains.
The adversary leveraged WMI for fileless execution, abused trusted binaries, conducted ransomware staging, and performed credential theft across multiple hosts.
Attack categories observed: Initial Access, Execution, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion, Credential Access, Discovery, Lateral Movement, Command & Control, Collection, Exfiltration.
Immediate containment, host isolation, and full forensic investigation are required.
